title: Synaptic
description: A capture-first learning app: dump raw notes as text, images or voice, and AI organizes them into structured pages with highlighted key concepts, an interactive concept map per topic and short daily review sessions focused on what you haven't mastered yet. Google Classroom and Calendar integrations, multilingual, installable PWA, built solo end-to-end.

title: Cadence
description: A calm, mobile-first personal growth app for people with many interests: agenda, routines, home chores, reading, movement and quick expenses in one place. An AI assistant turns what you say or type into tasks and expenses you confirm. Installable PWA.

title: GridCast
description: Upload once, publish everywhere: schedule your social media posts from a single place. Google sign-in, and every user only ever sees their own content.

title: Lagoa · Estudio digital
description: My freelance studio site: websites with bookings, WhatsApp assistants, online shops and Google Maps presence for local businesses, each with a live demo you can try before hiring.

title: Yutori Espacio Creativo
description: Website for a creative workshop space in A Coruña: watercolour, crochet, sewing and embroidery classes, monthly workshops, private sessions and gift vouchers, with its own admin panel.

title: Iago · Asesor fiscal
description: Website for an online tax advisor: tax returns, self-employed paperwork, inheritances and grants, explained without jargon. Bilingual (ES/CA) with playful draggable stickers.

title: Larder
description: Product overview for a shared-fridge grocery app: the lista de la compra generates itself from what's actually in your fridge. Proyecto Transversal (2º DAM).

title: Kook
description: A recipe finder that turns loose fridge ingredients into real recipes, with AI-generated cooking tips.
